subject: ddl: forbid drop/rename on system tables in nextgen and change BR to never physical restore system tables (#65756)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff focusing on DDL/metadata behavior. In nextgen builds, `DROP TABLE/VIEW/SEQUENCE` now treats reserved-ID schema objects (`metadef.IsReservedID`) as undroppable via `isUndroppableTable`, and `RENAME TABLE` is forbidden for reserved-ID tables, aligning with existing nextgen forbids (e.g., TRUNCATE/DROP SCHEMA). Coverage was added via unit/serial tests (e.g., `mysql.tidb_global_task`); no Blocker/High issues found in `pkg/ddl`. Later upstream commits touching `pkg/ddl/executor.go` did not modify this reserved-ID protection logic; BR-related changes were out of scope per review constraints.
